statement: For each residual direction A_res in {X,Z} and each allowed source/test material label m, define beta_{A_res}^m:=partial_{A_res,N} ln mu_obs^m.
derivation: This is the differential source charge in eta_source_mn. It is distinct from common-mode source charge.

statement: If the parent matter/source functor uses one q-owned action density and species/material labels theta_m are q-owned or superselected, then beta_{A_res}^m=beta_{A_res}^n for all m,n.
identity: Lie_{A_res,N} theta_m=0 and no species-dependent source prefactor => Delta beta_{A_res}^{mn}=0
derivation: The X/Z derivative sees only common q-data, so the material difference vanishes.

statement: If Delta beta_{A_res}^{mn}=0, source-charge WEP eta_source_mn is zero at the beta-difference level.
derivation: The denominator is finite for small or allowed charges; exact equality kills the differential signal.

statement: Species blindness does not imply beta_{A_res}^m=0. A common nonzero beta can pass eta_source_mn while still sourcing R10, Gdot, radial, EM, or source-normalization channels.
identity: beta_{A_res}^m=beta_{A_res}^n=beta_common != 0 => eta_source_mn=0 but J_A_source=rho_H beta_common/A_* may survive
derivation: WEP constrains differential charge; fifth-force and source-normalization channels also see common charge.

statement: The live corpus has the conditional theorem but not the parent no-marker/source-blind signature.

derivation: Existing gates retain species/material marker, EM-binding, clock marker, and source-prefactor failure modes.
